tool.name: Okta for AI Agents
tool.description: Discovers, registers and governs AI agents in Okta Universal Directory with scoped tokens, vaulted secrets and access reviews.
strengths: Shadow agent detection via OAuth grants
Agent SSO via Cross App Access
tool.pricing: Okta for AI Agents is a separate paid subscription; Agent SSO is included in core Okta SSO at no additional cost.
tool.practitionerNote: Strongest fit where Okta is already the workforce IdP; start with the no-cost Agent SSO, then weigh the paid suite for discovery, certification reviews and the agent kill switch.

dataResidency.detail: Agent-specific data residency is not described in the GA announcement or AI agents docs reviewed.

deployment.detail: Delivered as part of Okta's cloud identity service; no self-hosted option described.

auditLogging.detail: Audit via System Log events, plus SIEM telemetry streaming for agent activity.

soc2.detail: Okta trust center lists SOC 2; product-level scope is not broken out on the overview.

iso27001.detail: Okta trust center lists ISO/IEC 27001:2022; product-level scope is not broken out on the overview.

iso42001.detail: ISO/IEC 42001 is not listed on the Okta trust center overview.

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary; sold as a separate Okta subscription, with agent identities held in Okta Universal Directory.
